full_judgment:
2. The opposite party Nos. 1 to 3 as plaintiffs on 24-3-92 instituted the suit against the petitioner and another for declaration that the 'Sole' (compromise) judgment and decree of the Subordinate Judge at Bhola dated 11-3-92 and 19-3-92 respectively passed in Title Suit No. 27 of 1991 is fraudulent, collusive, illegal, null and void, and not binding upon them. The plaint case, in short, is that the entire land of 2.25 acre including the suit land measuring about 1.8925 acre appertaining to RS Khatian No. 604 corresponding to SA Khatian No. 961 was originally possessed by proforma-defendant No. 2, Md Haris as Korsha raiyat under the rent receiver, Usha Rani. Then, Usha Rani obtained a rent decree against Md Haris in Rent Suit No. 2300 of 1955 and in execution of the decree in Rent Execution Case No. 1342 of 1955; the entire land of the Khatian was sold in auction. On 14-1-55 Abdul Barik purchased said 2.25 acre of land in auction and on 17-2-55 he got delivery of possession of said land through Court. While he was thus owner in possession of said 2.25 acre of land, by registered deeds of sale dated 22-7-58 and 8-8-64 Abdul Barik transferred 1.20 acre of land to the plaintiff Nos.1 and 2 and delivered them possession. Similarly thereafter, his heirs also transferred the rest of the suit land to the plaintiffs by various registered documents. 

 4. The defendant No. 1 alone appeared and contested the suit by filing a written statement. His main case is that Md Haris transferred the entire land of RS Khatian No. 604 to him by way of pattan by granting a rent receipt. The defendant has since pattan been in possession of the entire land of the Khatian. He also denied the possession of Abdul Barik as well as of the plaintiff in the suit land. 

 11. We have perused the record. Admitted position is that the entire land measuring 2.25 acre appertaining to RS Khatian No. 604 was correctly recorded in the name of proforma defendant No. 2, Md Haris as a Korsha raiyot under Usha Rani. Usha Rani obtained a rent decree against said Haris in the Rent Suit No. 2300 of 1955 and in execution of the decree got the tenancy sold in auction in Rent Execution case No.1342 of 1955. Case of the plaintiffs is that Abdul Barik purchased the entire land in said auction sale and on 17-2-55 got delivery of possession through Court. While the defendant No.1 though admitted such auction sale but took the stand that Abdul Batik could not take delivery of possession and, as such, the auction was not acted upon. 

 16. We have already affirmed the finding of the Court of appeal below that the plaintiffs have proved their long possession in the suit land on the basis of their purchase vide exhibits 1 series, and defendant No. 1 failed to prove his possession in any part of the suit land. On 6-7-91 defendant No.1 instituted Title Suit No. 27 of 1991 against proforma defendant No. 2, Md Haris only for declaration of his title in the entire land appertaining to RS Khatian No. 604 including the suit land by way of a lease. Said RS Khatian appears to have recorded the name of Md Haris as Korsha raiyat under the rent receiver, Usha Rani. According to the list of rent receivers of the area at the relevant time as printed at page 14 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 by the Dhaka Law Reports, Second Edition, such Korsha raiyot had no rent receiving interest. If it is so, such Korsha raiyot had no right under law to create any sub-tenancy in respect of said land. The case of the defendant No.1 that he took lease of the suit land from proforma defendant No. 2, therefore, falls through as a hoax. Neither in this suit nor in the earlier suit, he could say definitely when he actually took lease. He just produced a piece of paper dated 5-1-55 to evidence an admission of proforma defendant No. 2 as to lease, which he did not take any step to prove. Dr Rafiqur Rahman has submitted that in 1955 no one could validly lease out any land. It may also be mentioned that the defendant No. 1 did not say a word about such admission of proforma defendant No. 2 in his earlier suit. Similarly, he got marked exhibit 'Kha' which appears to be a counterfoil of a rent receipt, which was also not proved.
